misconceptions.description: Treating Excel error codes like #DIV/0! and #N/A as random glitches instead of specific signals about the data or formula
misconceptions.trigger: learner sees an error code and tries cosmetic fixes like widening the column
misconceptions.feedback: Read the error code as a clue. #DIV/0! means a divide-by-zero, and #N/A from a lookup means no match was found, often from spaces or a text-vs-number mismatch.

misconceptions.description: Accepting an AI-suggested formula rewrite as correct because it sounds confident, without testing it against a known answer
misconceptions.trigger: learner pastes an AI rewrite back into the sheet without verifying it
misconceptions.feedback: Test the AI rewrite on a row whose correct answer you already know. Confidence is not correctness.

misconceptions.description: Asking an AI tool for help with only a vague description instead of the exact formula, error message, and expected result
misconceptions.trigger: learner prompts with 'fix my spreadsheet' and no specifics
misconceptions.feedback: Include the exact formula text, the error message, and the expected result for one specific row so the tool can diagnose the real cause.
